evidence: Adds `btck_witness_stack_get_items` to `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h` and implements it in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp`.
rationale: Avoids O(n^2) overhead when kernel consumers read an entire serialized witness stack. As described, 'reading a whole witness stack with btck_witness_stack_get_item_at is O(n^2)... This function gets every item in one O(n) pass', providing a cleaner, more efficient batch access API.
